question: Who was the Governor-General during the Anglo-Nepal war?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Hastings**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Anglo-Nepal War took place between **1814 and 1816**.
 
• It was fought between Nepal and the British East India Company.
 
• The War marked the rise of the Gurkha kingdom and the consolidation of the British East India Company's influence in Nepal.
 
• Lord Hastings​
 
 
• He served as Governor-General of India from 1813 to 1823.
 
• The Gurkha War (Anglo-Nepalese) and the Third Anglo-Maratha war occurred during his tenure.
 
• He abolished the Censorship Act.
 
 
 
• The war ended with the **Treaty of Sugauli**, in which Nepal ceded some of its territory to the East India Company.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Auckland**

 
 
• Auckland was appointed Governor-General in the year **1836**.
 
• George Eden, Earl of Auckland served from 1836 to 1842.
 
• The first Anglo-Afghan war was fought during his tenure.
 
• He is known for the expansion of the commercial industry in India.
 
 
 
• **Lord Hardinge**
 
 
• His career was a memorable one which included the visit of King George V to India and the **Delhi Durbar** of 1911, as well as the move of the capital from **Calcutta **to **New Delhi** in 1911.
 
 
 
• **Lord Wellesley**
 
 
• **Subsidiary Alliance** was a system devised by Lord Wellesley in 1798.
 
• In **1798**, **Lord Wellesley** became the Governor-General.
